question: What does 21 CFR 820.10 require?
answer_raw:
(a) Document [2] requires a manufacturer subject to this part to document a quality management system that complies with the applicable requirements of ISO 13485 (incorporated by reference, see § 820.7) and other applicable requirements of this part.  

(b) Applicable regulatory requirements [3] require compliance with the other applicable regulatory requirements in this title, including, but not limited to, the listed ISO 13485 Clause. The requirements include: [4] for Clause 7.5.8 in ISO 13485, [5] for Clause 7.5.9.1 in ISO 13485, [6] for Clause 8.2.3 in ISO 13485, and [7] for Clauses 7.2.3, 8.2.3, and 8.3.3 in ISO 13485.  

(c) Design and development [8] requires manufacturers of class II, class III, and those class I devices listed in paragraph (c)(1) of this section and table 1 to paragraph (c)(2) of this section to comply with the requirements in Design and Development, Clause 7.3 and its Subclauses in ISO 13485. The class I devices are as follows: [9] devices automated with computer software and [10] the devices listed in the following table.  

(d) Devices that support or sustain life [11] require manufacturers of devices that support or sustain life, the failure of which to perform when properly used in accordance with instructions for use provided in the labeling can be reasonably expected to result in a significant injury, to comply with the requirements in Traceability for Implantable Devices, Clause 7.5.9.2 in ISO 13485, in addition to all other applicable requirements in this part.  

(e) Enforcement [12] requires that failure to comply with any applicable requirement in this part renders a device adulterated under section 501(h) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act. Such a device, as well as any person responsible for the failure to comply, is subject to regulatory action.
